mission.title: License
mission.description: Trace data stolen by the Merovingian, then take Halborn to Veil when the System cannot help him itself.

npc.say: We'll show him some real action.
I heard he has quite a ship...

phase.briefing:
Our investigation of E Pluribus Neo at the old Zion site revealed that they have indeed reinforced the city's defense structure, but they do not appear to use it to house a central database. If they are storing the encrypted data that the Oracle gave them there, it would require an extraordinarily adept spy, or a full-scale assault on the city, to locate and retrieve it. Neither of these projects can be executed immediately.
Let us therefore turn to another topic: the Merovingian has stolen data concerning the planet's topography. We have ascertained that the information passed through a certain hub server under his control, but the data trail from that server is blocked. You are to proceed to the server's location, and investigate.

enter.say: Lots of network activity in there, and unregistered sentient programs. Let's look for some answers.

done.say:
Let's see... Second one goes to some kind of low-security file server--standard stuff... That first one... Damn, I'm not getting through.
Looks like someone's been cooking up their own protocol... Wait a sec, that address--that's the format the General used to use on his Matrix network--you know, the one we completely demolished.
Hm... I'm not getting in there any time soon. Gonna need to call Gray in on this.

phase.briefing: Check the connected file server's site, operative. An investigation of the other network will take some time.

enter.say: Got heavy network traffic in there, some unknown programs... Doesn't look like anything we can't handle.

done.say:
Hey, the data just went all--
Ah, crap. Not that guy.

talk.say: I need information. Set it up.

done.say: Guh... All right, we'd better tell Gray...

phase.briefing:
The direct conflict between Halborn and Carlyne has been escalating. Carlyne coordinated an attack on Halborn with Zion that proved to be a failure. Whether or not that has something to do with Halborn's request for a meeting remains to be seen.
The arrangements have been made. You will find Agent Pace ready to receive Halborn at the location indicated.

enter.say:
Gray's kinda been avoiding Halborn, hasn't he? And we haven't seen the Colonel--uh...the Architect--coming out to meet and greet either. Hm.
Well, Pace is showing up in there. Let's see what the big H wants this time.

talk.say: Cypherites? Rrr... Funny little system you've got here. You claim the rules don't allow you to tell me where his ship is yourselves, but your little under-the-table spies are allowed to do it, as long as it's much more of a pain in the rear for everyone involved? Phah! That's some real "efficiency," all right!

Yes, I've informed him that he should consult Veil about obtaining the location of Carlyne's ship. Our own ability to give out such information is restricted.
I would like you to accompany Halborn at the meeting. You must tell Veil that unfortunately, we were unable to give him the information ourselves, and that we rely upon her to treat him as he deserves. This will ensure that there is no...misunderstanding between the two sides.

done.say: Agent Gray will have further instructions for you, {player}. Please listen to them very carefully.

objective.text: Lead Halborn out of the area

phase.briefing: When you deliver Agent Pace's message to Veil, operative, make no mention of the Cypherite leader, Cryptos, within Halborn's presence. We prefer that Halborn deal with Veil.

enter.say: Ugh, Cypherites. Maybe we'll get lucky, and Veil will hijack Halborn's ship, and then we can put her and the Cyphs away for...uh...piracy or something.

done.say: Are you sure this woman's a qualified pilot?
Oh, they'll make quite the pair.

talk.say: Of course, sweetie! We'll take care of him. Don't you worry!

done.say: Bleh; I don't like it when she laughs. You're not gonna be hanging around in there, are you?

We have all kinds of interesting places we can take him. Oh, and where that other guy has his ship, of course.
Why don't you come along, honey? It'll be a gas!

mission.finish: The arrangement appears to have been satisfactory. Thank you, {player}. You may return to your other duties.
